generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A provider response is accepted by comparing a blended textual identity, so a correct-looking field can compensate for a contradictory structured field or cited source.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Treat concatenated provider output as one identity string and accept it when any representation echoes the request, without reconciling authoritative fields independently.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Before accepting an exact provider-backed result, validate each authoritative structured identity field independently, reject cross-field contradictions, and require cited evidence to support the discriminating identity rather than only numeric payloads.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Adversarial controls must vary at least two independent provider fields and the evidence source so that echoed free text cannot hide a conflicting structured value.
